Subject: CloudVista renewal: term consolidation & capacity ops launch

Hi Liam —

Following our renewal signal last week, I wanted to get a short kickoff thread in your inbox to align timeline, stakeholders, and an initial QBR window. High-level proposal below:

- Goal: Consolidate our multiple contracts into a single 12-month term with a capacity surge buffer and a staged uplift plan (Q3 start).
- Timeline: legal review + pricing by 4/24, ops prep 5/6–5/17, QBR week (exec + ops) target the week of 5/20.
- Ask: can you confirm the internal approvers (procurement, legal, SRE lead) and whether the 5/20 week works?

I've attached a one-pager timeline and a starter capacity projection for discussion (CloudVista_Renewal_Timeline.xlsx). Marissa from our Customer Success team is looped to run the QBR.

Next steps I suggest from Redwood:
1) Share draft term amendment + pricing play by 4/18 (owner: Grace)
2) Contracts sync between Redwood legal and CloudVista contracts on 4/22 (owner: legal teams)
3) Ops handoff: capacity runbook and spike test 5/6–5/10 (owner: Ben)

If you prefer a calendar poll, I can send one — otherwise please reply with the approver names and a preferred QBR day.

Thanks,

— Grace O'Connor

Adding ops context from our side — thanks for mapping stakeholders, Liam. A few operational notes and a proposed ramp plan:

- Current baseline: CloudVista averages ~1.6M tokens/day with seasonal peaks up to 3.8M/day (see attached projection).
- Proposed uplift: reserve a 40% buffer for burst months and enable an opt-in short-term burst pool for Q4.
- Canary approach: we recommend a staged traffic migration across two dedicated clusters (stage A: 10% traffic for 2 weeks, stage B: 50% for 1 week, then cutover) to avoid cold-start token latency regressions.

Deliverables we can provide by 5/6: capacity runbook, automated load script, and spike test report. Attachment: capacity-projection.csv

Ben

4) QBR scheduling: proposed main QBR Tue 21 May (exec readout) + Wed 22 May (tech deep dive). I've started a Doodle poll: https://doodle.com/poll/qbr-poll-cloudvista-2029-04. If the week changes we'll re-run the poll.
